cues: A discourse marker cannot join two clauses by itself: it was late, however we continued, is wrong.
Use a full stop, or a semicolon, before it and a comma after it.
Also: a comma before a coordinating conjunction that joins two full clauses; a comma after a subordinate clause at the front; and no comma when the subordinate clause comes second.
